name: China Masters
stakes: This China Masters is a crucial test for India's top players to find form and consistency on the demanding BWF tour, especially with Satwik & Chirag aiming for a Super 750 title.
summary:
India's campaign at the China Masters Super 750 has seen a mixed bag of fortunes, with the spotlight firmly on the men's doubles sensation, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty. The fifth-seeded pair has powered into the semifinals, continuing their impressive form and carrying the nation's hopes deep into the tournament. They face a challenging Malaysian duo, Nur Mohd. Azriyn Ayub Azriyn and Tan Wee Kiong, in what promises to be a thrilling encounter.

However, for many other Indian shuttlers, the journey in Shenzhen ended prematurely. Women's singles star PV Sindhu, along with emerging talents like Malvika Bansod and the promising women's doubles pair of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, faced early exits in the opening round. Men's singles players Lakshya Sen and veteran Kidambi Srikanth also couldn't make a deep run, with Sen falling in R32 and Srikanth exiting in the quarterfinals. The mixed doubles pair of Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto also bowed out early.

Despite the early departures for a significant portion of the contingent, Satwik and Chirag's consistent performance at this Super 750 event underscores their status as one of the world's elite pairs. Their continued presence in the business end of such a prestigious tournament offers a beacon of hope and a chance for India to clinch a title in China.
